# Brand title

The brand-title recipe: a full-bleed brand gradient with the logo and one centred headline in the brand font, and no review labels. Made for muted loops such as website hero videos.

- Type: Brand title
- Skill: `magnifito-promo`
- Engine: `hyperframes`
- Output: 1920x1080, 5 s, silent
- Video: [`../videos/s17-brand-title.mp4`](../videos/s17-brand-title.mp4)

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> Use the magnifito-promo skill to make a 5-second 16:9 muted title card for the Magnifito website hero, in the brand-title style: our logo (assets/magnifito-logo.svg) over the tagline "Digital marketing with heart and value" on the brand gradient. Brand: warm browns on cream (#7a584c, #ae8c72, #f0eadf), dark ink #2b1c17, Geist from fonts/. Render it with HyperFrames.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- s17-brand-title
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/s17-brand-title/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
mgvideo render . --force
```

The finished file is `runs/*/final_output_*.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
